question: This chart shows non-preemptive Shortest Job First. Why do P9, P8 and P7 run in that order, why does P12 wait so long, and what is the average waiting time?
reference_answer: When P6 finishes at t=9, P7 (burst 3), P8 (2) and P9 (1), all arrived at 7, are waiting; SJF picks the shortest burst first: P9 9-10, P8 10-12, P7 12-15, so they wait 2, 3 and 5. P12 (burst 3, arrives 13) is passed over at t=18 by the shorter P13 (1) and P14 (2), which arrived at 17, so it runs 21-24 and waits 21-13 = 8. Waiting times P1..P14: 0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 3, 5, 3, 2, 2, 3, 8, 1, 2; total 33, average 33/14 = 2.36 time units.
